pages.layoutNotes: Single-column page (right page of spread; next page 'Dessert' partly visible at right edge). Lilac/mauve rounded pill headings: 'Smoothies' top-left with '€ 5,00' to its right; 'Pancake' mid-right with '€ 5,00' right-aligned and topping list below. 'The Smoothie Factory – Real fruit real good' logo mid-left plus three badges (Vegan, 100% Fruit, Senza glutine/Gluten free). Bottom: rectangular photos – fruit & juice glasses (left) and chocolate-topped pancake stack (right). White paper.
